criteria.requirement: Implement bibtexparser.crossref.ResolveCrossrefMiddleware(missing="error") as a non-mutating LibraryMiddleware. Resolve nested case-sensitive crossref dependencies, inherit only missing fields, map parent title to booktitle for inproceedings/incollection and preserve explicit child values including empty strings. Record inherited field sources in parser metadata, reject cycles and failed/duplicate blocks, and allow explicit missing="ignore". Keep the default parse stack unchanged and preserve source object isolation.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
